milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the cobblestone staircase and face it to confirm visual discovery. The staircase spans from spawn-relative (8,0,10) to (12,4,10), so the target is set to the midpoint at (10,2,10). max_distance=16 is appropriate for a 'find' task since the player can visually identify the distinctive stair-shaped blocks from moderate range. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking at the stairs, not just passing nearby.

Uses position_near_with_facing because ringing a bell is a block interaction (right-click) that may not reliably appear in the use_item event counter. The bell is at spawn-relative (13,5,10) on the elevated platform. max_distance=3 is deliberately tight — it confirms the player actually climbed the cobblestone staircase and reached the platform (the bell is 5 blocks above ground, inaccessible without ascending the stairs). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the bell, modeling the 'ready to interact' state. This proxy is the most reliable available check for bell interaction.
